qualifier: social, reproductive and drug-reward behavior and conditioning
name: Social, reproductive and drug-reward behavior and conditioning
rationale: All members are organism-level behaviors (mating, parental, aggressive, drinking, conditioned learning, cocaine/ethanol responses), unlike confusables built on neuropeptide, opioid or dopamine receptor signaling and sleep regulation.

qualifier: proliferation, survival and differentiation control in thymus
name: Regulation of thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation
rationale: Every member regulates immature T cell proliferation, apoptosis or differentiation in the thymus, distinguishing it from bone-marrow/myeloid and mature T cell activation confusables.

qualifier: MYC targets and nutrient-dependent rRNA gene silencing
name: MYC- and nutrient-regulated ribosome biogenesis, rRNA gene silencing
rationale: Members govern ribosome biogenesis output (MYC target programs, methionine response, SIRT1/nucleolar chromatin repression of Pol I), whereas confusables hold the Pol I transcription and rRNA processing machinery itself.

core: Peroxisome biogenesis and anabolic lipid metabolism
qualifier: protein import, VLCFA elongation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisome protein import with VLCFA and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal protein targeting/import and fission plus biosynthetic lipid routes (very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA elongation, plasmalogen/ether and wax synthesis, LA/ALA metabolism), while confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: foam cell formation, cholesterol import, storage and efflux
name: Macrophage foam cell cholesterol uptake, storage and efflux
rationale: All members concern lipoprotein/oxLDL-driven cholesterol import, storage, LXR-driven efflux and foam cell differentiation, distinct from HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport confusables.

qualifier: chemosensation (taste, smell, pheromone) plus pain and temperature
name: Chemosensory and pain/temperature sensory transduction
rationale: Members are taste, smell, pheromone, itch, pain and thermosensory perception with their TRP and two-pore K+ channels, whereas confusables lack the taste and olfactory receptor systems.

qualifier: integrin-mediated adhesion to endothelium and diapedesis
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, integrin activation, PECAM1 interactions, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike monocyte inflammation, immunological synapse or chemokine confusables.

qualifier: uptake and compartmentalization by SLC39/SLC30 transporters
name: Cellular zinc uptake, compartmentalization and homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns zinc import, efflux, organelle compartmentalization or zinc-deficiency disease, separating it from copper, manganese and cadmium transport confusables.

qualifier: erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptors
name: Erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are EPO receptor downstream branches (PI3K, STAT5, PLCG, RAS) or TPO signaling, distinct from FLT3, growth hormone/prolactin and ALK confusables.

core: Inositol phosphate signaling and PI3K/AKT restraint
qualifier: inositol polyphosphate synthesis and post-transcriptional PTEN control
name: Inositol polyphosphate synthesis and PTEN restraint of PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members combine nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis with ceRNA/lncRNA control of PTEN and negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF signaling, unlike confusables on AKT targets, PTEN localization/stability or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

qualifier: respiratory chain regulation plus oxidative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Respiratory chain regulation and oxidative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS output together with hydrogen peroxide/hypoxia-triggered intrinsic apoptosis, which no single confusable (ferroptosis, PGC-1alpha, depolarization) combines.

qualifier: severing, barbed-end capping and depolymerization
name: Actin filament severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: All three members dismantle or cap actin filaments, opposite to the polymerization, lamellipodium and crosslinking confusables.

qualifier: receptor-level FZD/LRP, DVL and AXIN regulation
name: Canonical Wnt signalosome: FZD/LRP, DVL and AXIN turnover
rationale: Members act at the membrane-proximal canonical Wnt step (FZD ubiquitination/RNF43, LRP5, DVL activation and degradation, AXIN degradation and recruitment, ligand antagonists), whereas confusables cover non-canonical Ca2+ Wnt, nuclear TCF/beta-catenin output or Wnt secretion.

qualifier: mature mRNA transit through the nuclear pore
name: Mature mRNA export through the nuclear pore
rationale: Members cover export of spliced, intronless and histone mature mRNAs and positive regulation of RNA export via nuclear pore components, unlike confusables on pore assembly, ribosome/Rev export or mRNA 3' processing and decay.

qualifier: vesicle clustering, presynaptic cytoskeleton and dendrite/receptor stability
name: Synapse structure and modulation of neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic cytoskeleton, vesicle clustering, spontaneous transmission and neurotransmitter secretion/uptake, plus dendrite extension and receptor internalization, which the vesicle release and endocytic recycling confusables lack.

qualifier: PPARalpha and PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis program
name: PPARalpha/PGC-1alpha transcriptional response to fatty acids
rationale: All three members are the transcriptional response to fatty acids via PPARA and PGC-1alpha-driven mitochondrial biogenesis, distinct from fatty acid oxidation, PPARG adipogenesis and LXR lipogenesis confusables.

qualifier: vitamin D activation and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members are vitamin D hydroxylation/catabolism and its CYP defects plus vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors, separating it from phosphate/mineralization and retinoic acid confusables.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and its CYP enzyme defects
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroid biosynthesis and CYP enzyme defects
rationale: Members span pregnenolone, progestin, androgen, estrogen, glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis with steroidogenic CYP deficiencies, whereas confusables are aldosterone/cortisol regulation or retinoid and vitamin D CYP metabolism.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S program
name: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
rationale: Members are E2F target and network sets, G1/S-specific transcription and cell cycle modules, unlike confusables centred on DNA replication initiation or the G2/M checkpoint.

qualifier: extracellular matrix crosslinking and turnover
name: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix crosslinking and turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C metabolism/transport and antioxidant vitamin responses with collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, hyaluronan degradation and proteoglycan synthesis, the ECM side that the ROS, BH4, iron and vitamin K confusables lack.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol membrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, whereas confusables carry cationic amino acids, ornithine and oligopeptides.

qualifier: stress/oncogene induction, SASP and Polycomb-controlled cycle exit
name: Stress-induced cellular senescence, SASP and Polycomb control
rationale: Members are oxidative-stress and oncogene-induced senescence, SASP, G0 exit restraint and BMI1/Polycomb silencing, unlike confusables on UV response, SAHF/replicative senescence or senescence evasion in cancer.

qualifier: microglial/astrocyte activation and APP/amyloid-beta production
name: Glial activation and amyloid precursor protein processing regulation
rationale: Members regulate microglial and astrocyte activation, glial proliferation/apoptosis and APP metabolism, amyloid-beta formation and tangle assembly, whereas confusables focus on amyloid fibril formation and clearance.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and tubulin post-translational modification
name: CCT/TRiC cytoskeletal protein folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members are prefoldin/CCT folding of actin, tubulin and G-beta plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, which general chaperone and histone acetylation confusables lack.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin renal water handling and cellular osmotic response
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water balance and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover vasopressin receptors and aquaporin water reabsorption, osmosensing, hyper/hypotonic responses and renal sodium handling, beyond the renin-angiotensin and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.
